name: daily-siege
description: Daily Siege: a daily asynchronous siege game for a group of friends

scripts.emulators: npm run build && npm run functions:sync && firebase emulators:start --project demo-dailysiege
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run functions:sync && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-dailysiege "node --test emulator-tests/e2e.spec.mjs"
